title: Portuguese Product Reviews with Pros and Cons
subtitle: 2.87M Brazilian product reviews with sentiment, 12.9M clauses and pros/cons
description:
**Reviews de produtos (pt-BR) com prós e contras**: 2,87 milhões de avaliações de 9 lojas brasileiras, com sentimento, 12,9 milhões de cláusulas e os prós e contras de 222 mil produtos. **Brazilian product reviews** with sentiment, clauses and pros and cons per product.

![Pros and cons from reviews](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CaiqueDourado/portuguese-product-reviews/main/docs/img/cover.png?v=2)

Reviews collected from 2017 to 2022 from the product pages of Americanas, Magazine Luiza, Submarino, Shoptime, Casas Bahia, Extra, Leroy Merlin, Ponto Frio and Fast Shop (written 2008–2019), for the author's review site *É bom? Vale a pena?* and data lake. About 22 times the size of B2W-Reviews01, the best-known Portuguese review dataset.

On top of the reviews, the 2020 pipeline that turned them into pros and cons:

![The five steps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CaiqueDourado/portuguese-product-reviews/main/docs/img/flow.png)

1. **Sentiment** of each review from AWS Comprehend.
2. **Part-of-speech tags** from the Stanford tagger (Portuguese model).
3. **Clauses** cut at punctuation and conjunctions.
4. **Grouped and counted** per product through six matching keys and a canonical form.
5. **Top 4 pros and 4 cons** per product.

## Where the reviews were shown

The collection started in 2017 for **É bom? Vale a pena?** ([archived](https://web.archive.org/web/20230106180533/https://opiniaobomvaleapena.com.br/)), one page per product with its reviews. Later the reviews and their pros and cons appeared on the product pages of the author's sites, such as [Tudo Sobre Produtos](https://web.archive.org/web/20251021032358/https://tudosobreprodutos.com.br/tudo-sobre-bebedouro-cadence-pure-vita-elegant-0v):

![Tudo Sobre Produtos (2020)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CaiqueDourado/CaiqueDourado/main/assets/tudosobreprodutos_primeira_versao.png)

## Files

- `reviews.parquet`: 2,871,096 reviews: stars, recommendation, title, text, AWS sentiment, helpfulness, dates, store.
- `sentences.parquet`: 12,896,607 clauses with POS tags, matching keys and canonical form.
- `aspect_ratings.parquet`: 2,484,634 scores per aspect (quality, design, battery, screen…).
- `pros_cons.parquet`: top 4 pros and 4 cons of 222,976 products.
- `groups.parquet`: product name, review count and average stars per product group.

`product_id` and `group_id` join with the [catalog of Brazilian e-commerce products](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/caiquedourado/catalogo-produtos-ecommerce-brasil) (prices, specifications, EANs).

## Cleaning and privacy

Nicknames, cities and author ids were never exported. E-mails, phone numbers and CPF-like numbers inside the texts are masked. About 28% of the texts had lost every ã/õ in collection ("nao", "funçao"); those words were restored from intact texts and the original kept in `text_original`. Sentiment is per review, not per clause, so a cons list can contain a positive clause from a negative review: the data quality report explains this and the other limits.

Methodology, data quality report, data dictionary (EN and PT), build scripts and a sample: **https://github.com/CaiqueDourado/portuguese-product-reviews**. Starter notebook (sentiment × stars, aspects, pros and cons of one product): [notebook-portuguese-product-reviews](https://www.kaggle.com/code/caiquedourado/notebook-reviews-produtos-ptbr).

## Related

- [Catálogo de produtos do e-commerce brasileiro](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/caiquedourado/catalogo-produtos-ecommerce-brasil)
- [Pares de produtos para matching](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/caiquedourado/pares-matching-produtos-ptbr)
- [Nomes e sobrenomes do Brasil](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/caiquedourado/nomes-e-sobrenomes-brasil) (same matching keys)
- [pros-e-contras-ptbr](https://github.com/CaiqueDourado/pros-e-contras-ptbr): Python library with the 2020 method and clause-level polarity (right cons 64.7% → 89.7%)
- [Case study: É bom? Vale a pena?](https://github.com/CaiqueDourado/portuguese-product-reviews/blob/main/docs/case-study-e-bom-vale-a-pena.md), the review site this data was collected for

resources.description: 2,871,096 reviews from 9 Brazilian stores (2008-2019): stars, text, AWS sentiment, helpfulness.

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: Review id in the author's database. Primary key.

fields.name: product_id
fields.description: Offer the review was collected from: `produtos.id` in the catalog dataset.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Product group (same product across stores): `grupos.id` in the catalog dataset and key of groups and pros_cons.

fields.name: store
fields.description: Store whose product page showed the review.

fields.name: rating
fields.description: Stars given by the customer, 1 to 5.

fields.name: recommended
fields.description: Whether the customer answered yes to "would you recommend this product?". Empty when not asked.

fields.name: ratings_only
fields.description: Review with stars and no text, as flagged by the review platform.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Review title written by the customer.

fields.name: text
fields.description: Review text. Store names were replaced by "loja" in 2020; e-mails, phone numbers and CPFs are masked; lost ã/õ restored (see text_original).

fields.name: text_original
fields.description: Text as collected, only when the ã/õ restoration changed it.

fields.name: tilde_restored
fields.description: True when ã/õ were restored in `text`.

fields.name: sentiment
fields.description: Sentiment of the whole review from AWS Comprehend (POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, NEUTRAL, MIXED); POSITIVE with 1-2 stars was changed to NEGATIVE in 2020.

fields.name: sentiment_aws_original
fields.description: AWS label before that change (only on the changed rows).

fields.name: helpfulness
fields.description: Share of readers who found the review useful, 0 to 1, as published by the platform.

fields.name: feedback_positive
fields.description: Readers who marked the review as useful.

fields.name: feedback_negative
fields.description: Readers who marked the review as not useful.

fields.name: comments
fields.description: Comments on the review.

fields.name: submitted_at
fields.description: When the customer submitted the review.

fields.name: modified_at
fields.description: Last change on the platform.

fields.name: locale
fields.description: Language and country of the review (pt_BR in 99.9% of the reviews that have it).

fields.name: syndicated
fields.description: Review shared from another site of the same review network, as flagged by the platform.

fields.name: campaign
fields.description: Where the review was collected (e-mail after purchase, product page, app...), as published by the platform.

fields.name: collected_at
fields.description: When the author's crawler saved the review.

resources.description: 12,896,607 clauses cut from the reviews by the 2020 method (Stanford POS tags), with matching keys and the canonical form.

fields.name: sentence_id
fields.description: Clause id. Primary key.

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: Review the clause came from.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Product group of the review.

fields.name: text
fields.description: The clause, cut at punctuation and conjunctions by the 2020 method; first letter upper case, the rest lower case.

fields.name: tagged
fields.description: The clause with Stanford POS tags (`palavra/TAG`), original case.

fields.name: canonical
fields.description: Canonical form inside the product group: the most frequent spelling among clauses that share a key. The column shown as pro/con.

fields.name: count_site
fields.description: How many times the same clause appears in the whole database (all products and stores).

fields.name: key_metaphone
fields.description: Portuguese Metaphone of the clause (empty for one-word clauses).

fields.name: key_fingerprint
fields.description: OpenRefine fingerprint, with the 2023 keyer bug (keeps every other word); empty under 3 words.

fields.name: key_tokens
fields.description: Stopwords removed and Brazilian stemmer applied; empty under 3 words.

fields.name: key_tokens_fingerprint
fields.description: The stems of key_tokens, sorted.

fields.name: key_ngram
fields.description: Character 2-gram fingerprint.

fields.name: key_soft
fields.description: Lower case, no accents, letters, digits and spaces only.

resources.description: 2,484,634 scores per aspect (quality, design, battery...) given in the reviews.

fields.name: review_id
fields.description: Review the score belongs to.

fields.name: aspect_key
fields.description: Aspect key as the store's form named it (QualidadeGeral, Design2, BatteryLife...).

fields.name: aspect
fields.description: Aspect in Portuguese, with the keys of different stores merged (Qualidade, Design, Bateria...).

fields.name: score
fields.description: Score given to that aspect, 1 to 5.

resources.description: Top 4 pros and 4 cons of 222,976 products, computed with the 2020 rule.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Product group.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: `pro` (from POSITIVE reviews) or `con` (from NEGATIVE reviews).

fields.name: rank
fields.description: 1 to 4, as shown on the product page.

fields.name: clause
fields.description: Canonical clause with at least two words.

fields.name: mentions
fields.description: Clauses of this group and sentiment with this canonical form (first sort key).

fields.name: count_site
fields.description: Frequency of the clause in the whole database (tie-break).

fields.name: example_review_id
fields.description: One review containing the clause.

resources.description: Name, review count and average stars of each product group.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: Product group. Primary key.

fields.name: group_name
fields.description: Product name of the group in the catalog.

fields.name: reviews
fields.description: Reviews of the group in this dataset.

fields.name: avg_rating
fields.description: Average stars of those reviews.
